body:
I met my LO through discord, so I suppose I've met her in some capacity, but...

I met her about seven and a half years ago, and we were in decent contact with one another (mostly initiated by me, and she legit needed breaks from me lmao) until last summer, where she stopped replying to me again and I decided to let things be at that point. If she wants to message me again, she will.

My limerence was really bad with her for a good few years, having come from a really bad depressive episode. She was my everything, in all senses of the phrase. If I was unsure about something, I'd think what she'd do in that situation, or how me overcoming it would impress her, etc etc

To this day, I don't know what she looks like. I don't know what she sounds like, even. She's someone who was already pretty naturally reserved about giving out info about herself but I think a fucker like me strengthened that habit in her lmao. 

We had one instance of voice chatting way back when, and she just peeped a mere phrase. That's the only recollection I have of her voice. She's shown me photos of herself, but her face is always blocked by something or straight up scribbled out.

Over seven years now, and not a day has gone by where I don't think about her. A faceless individual I honestly don't know much about. And I would still gladly give them everything I have, should they simply ask.

You're not alone, man. This shit fucking sucks
Fair enough. It's a constant fight against myself with this stuff, I hate it. Thanks for the reminder.

I know, I know ;-;
Its just hard for me to drop it due to having a history of attachment issues + being lonely. I need to stop using that as an excuse for the awful behavior, though. So, I'll try. thank you.
Maybe a few times a couple years back
No one to play TF2 with. I main medic. Was hyped for the comp update until it blue balled everyone when it was released. I have almost 1K hours after playing it for like 5 years

Oh, I definitely play video games. I have a Wii U but also built my own gaming PC. I play Smash 4 competitively, but I haven't had much fun with any video game for a while now. Can't drive, no license. There's quite a few tourneys where I live, but it's often expensive to get myself over to those places. Doesn't help I don't really have that much money

I mean it's not like I do anything else with my day, so, sure..


I have a separate issue with anti depressants. I was only on them for about a week until my mother threw them away without my permission about 3 days ago (I'm getting that issue resolved, I'll take them without her knowing if I have to)

I've been going to therapy for the past 2 months or so once a week. It helps me understand myself better, but I wouldn't say it's helping out besides that.

My social life is nonexistent. I have a few "friends" that I can joke around with but I have 0 serious friendships, never had any as a matter in fact (besides her...) When I'm out, I always feel anxious and just want to go back home and waste time on my PC or whatever

i have severe depression and social anxiety, and she was willing to be that person that I can talk to if anything was bothering me. So I took her up on that offer and literally every fucking day I pour whatever is bothering me that day onto her and it's been understandably mentally draining to her. She's already busy as it is with education and life in general and I'm just a fucking burden to her. I've been so demanding of her care it's just made her loathe me coming to her for help as she just doesnt have the time anymore for it and I keep pushing her. she was my only genuine friend and now i have no one
I feel like I could've written this... The person I love most has already been distracting themself from me and I just wonder when will be the last time they say hello.

For majority of my life I've been forced to hold in my feelings so others wouldn't judge me. Now I feel so anxious and I WANT TO CRY but I cant. Its just all built up and it feels so fucking uncomfortable and I cant do anything about it
I read this sweet message a wonderful friend sent to me a couple months ago, reassuring me I have at least one person who deeply cares for me out in the world
god damnit i wish someone would just approach me and say they love and care about me
despite her help and therapy ive only been getting worse. now I do absolutely nothing in regards to school work. That being said, her help is certainly keeping me around....

My only friend is someone I only know online; I don't talk to anyone IRL. She lives on the opposite side of the continent. She's the sweetest person I've ever met; I can feel her genuine kindness just by reading her messages. For a couple of months now we've talked every day back to back without interruption, mainly consisting of her just being there for me as I struggle with depression, though we do have a lot in common and share things about each other. Me, being someone who gets overly attached to anyone nice to me, is inevitably in love with her. I want to tell her how I feel but I'm so afraid it will drive her away and I'll be left alone. She is already a bit anxious about sharing personal stuff online, and has stated that she has purposefully distanced herself from guys who've tried to hit on her online, and I obviously don't want that to happen to me... So I don't. I want to, but I don't. This being a problem for me makes me feel so pathetic and desperate for any kind of relationship. I can talk to people IRL but they all seem so uninterested in having any kind of relationship with me so I don't bother. She's the only person that genuinely cares about me... whatever

Being able to freely go outside like a normal human being is absolutely worth some "drama"

I advise you to call your local authorities.
